subject: Trading
title: Morning and Evening Stars
description: Learn Morning and Evening Stars in one minute.

hook.text: Three candles tell a story: a trend, a pause, and a reversal. This trio is the star pattern.

buildup.text: A morning star appears at bottoms: big red candle, small-bodied candle, then a big green candle.

discovery.text: An evening star appears at tops: big green candle, small body, then a big red candle. The party is over.

twist.text: The middle candle—the star—can be a doji, spinner, or even a gap. The key is the pause between moves.

climax.text: Star patterns capture the full psychology of a reversal: conviction, doubt, and new conviction.

punchline.text: Trend. Pause. Reversal. Three acts, one turn.

quiz.question: What does a morning star pattern signal?
options: A potential reversal from bearish to bullish
